environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'chat-prod' behind AWS ALB Ingress Controller (v2.6.1) with annotation alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/actions.ws-filter configured as a fixed-response-403 for requests missing the custom header X-Internal-Mesh-Route. Istio VirtualService with CorsPolicy specifying allowOrigins with exact match on 'https://app.company.com' applied at the mesh gateway level. Additionally, an Istio AuthorizationPolicy in CUSTOM mode delegates to an ext-authz service (OPA) that validates the Origin header against an allowlist AND checks that the :authority pseudo-header matches the registered service FQDN. The EnvoyFilter resource patches the HTTP connection manager to inject 'use_remote_address: true' and 'xff_num_trusted_hops: 1', ensuring the real client origin is evaluated. PgBouncer runs with prepared_statement_mode=server and max_client_conn=50.
